titulo: B1 review and mock test: Writing and speaking (B1 format)

aula.objetivo: Take an honest stock of your level, practice reading, listening, writing and speaking in the B1 format and take an original mock test.

blocos.titulo: How to write and speak well at B1
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: plan in three parts: introduction (topic and position), development (two or three arguments with examples) and conclusion. STEP 2: use one connector per paragraph: «d'abord», «en revanche», «par conséquent», «bref». STEP 3: vary the tenses: passé composé and imparfait to narrate; conditional for opinion or hypothesis; subjunctive after «il faut que», «bien que», «pour que». STEP 4: always recheck agreement (participles, adjectives) and pronoun order. STEP 5: in the oral exam, describe and give opinions: «à mon avis», «ce qui m'intéresse», «je suis convaincu que». STEP 6: if a word is missing, work around it: «un truc qui sert à…». STEP 7: manage your time: 2 minutes to plan, 8 to write, 2 to reread.

tabela.example: «De nos jours, beaucoup de gens pensent que…»

blocos.enunciado: Write a 120-word text: «Faut-il apprendre une langue étrangère pour travailler ?». Use at least four connectors. Then read it aloud.
Reread your most common B1 mistakes from lesson 61.
